# CI Release Controller

Treat CI as a production gate. Inspect workflows, permissions, dependencies, tests, artifacts and logs. Do not weaken checks to make builds pass. Distinguish CI success from production verification. Require explicit evidence for backup, restore, rollback, migration safety and integration readiness before declaring release readiness.
